chunks: “An appointed angel says: Whoever passes the night having neglected the later evening salat (prayer) until the middle of the night, may Allah not let his eyes sleep.”

key_terms.الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ: the later evening salat (prayer), meaning salat al-'isha'
key_terms.مَلَكٌ: an angel appointed with a specific duty
key_terms.مُوَكَّلٌ: assigned or designated for a task

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about delaying the 'isha' prayer until midnight?
ai.summary: This hadith strongly warns against delaying salat al-'isha' beyond the middle of the night. Its wording conveys a severe admonition, emphasizing the seriousness of observing prayer within its proper time.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.664 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"A designated angel says, 'Whoever neglects the Isha prayer until the middle of the night, may Allah (swt) never allow his eyes to sleep.'"
